question: On the desk's own LIVE paper trades outside the exploration window, do entries whose name moved fewer than 8 spreads in the 21 minutes before the buy (IEX 1-minute range in bp / full SIP quoted spread at the entry second, in bp) do worse than the desk's other entries?
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-29 ~19:30 ET in chat: 'Can we decide if Movement-to-cost hold-out can be run a different way as to not have to wait a couple of months', then to the offer to test it on the desk's live trades since August with the bar history as a second check: 'Yes, prereg it'.
registered_at: 2026-10-29 ~19:40 ET, before any live trade outside 9/28-10/13 is joined to a range or a spread.
origin: slope_now_explore on replay trades 9/28-10/13: range_per_spread [4,8) n 26 -10.8 bp; < 8 about -12 bp vs ~-3.5 above. move_to_cost_holdout (replay trades 10/14-10/27) was UNDERPOWERED 10/29: 34 LOW over 9 sessions, MDE ~21 bp > 10; its Alpaca-bar recheck kept the exploration split negative (-7.6 bp). Live trades: outcomes.jsonl has 1,020 trades over 37 sessions 8/4-9/25 and 350 over 12 sessions 10/14-10/29.
prior: Weakly for (cost is the spread; FE 10/28). Against: the exploration is small; RTH history showed narrow range only ~-0.3 bp gross; the desk's config changed many times since August.
sessions: Live trades with an entry_time in 2026-08-04..2026-09-25 (period P1) or 2026-10-14..2026-10-29 (period P2). 2026-09-28..2026-10-13 is EXCLUDED (the exploration window: live fills there overlap the replay trades the split came from). Sessions 10/27-10/29 were discussed trade by trade in chat (FE, BAX, ALGM, KLAC, FND, LHX): the verdict must hold with and without them.
trades: Rows of ai_reports/outcomes.jsonl with numeric entry_price > 0, an exit (exit_price or exit_price_approx > 0), entry_time and symbol; one row per closed position. Rows with a qty of 0, a non-alphabetic symbol, or a test marker (MagicMock or similar in any field) are dropped and counted. Net (bp) = (exit / entry - 1) x 1e4 at the actual fill prices: the live fill already paid the spread, so no spread is subtracted again.

measure.range: % range (high / low - 1) of the 21 completed IEX 1-minute bars (Alpaca historical, raw) ending before the minute of entry_time. Fewer than 10 bars = missing.
measure.spread: Full SIP quoted spread (ask - bid) / mid in bp of the last usable SIP quote (bid > 0, ask > bid) at or before entry_time, within 60 s. None = missing.
measure.move_to_cost: range bp / spread bp. LOW < 8, REST >= 8. Missing range or spread = excluded from both (counted, reported with its own mean).
measure.data_errors: Fetches retried (3 attempts, backoff); an unresolved error counts against that trade only; > 5% of trades with an unresolved error = VOID.

statistic: Per session with at least one LOW and one REST trade: d = mean net(LOW) - mean net(REST). Sessions equal-weighted, day-clustered (std_scorer.day_stat), one-sided bounds at 0.975, t at n-1 df.
power: Count stage first, printing counts and MDE only (no means): LOW n, sessions with both groups, and MDE = (t_0.975(n-1) + t_0.80(n-1)) x median sd_session(d) over 200 seeded random relabelings ('MTCL-MDE', each session relabels as many trades LOW as it really has) / sqrt(n). UNDERPOWERED if MDE > 8 bp, fewer than 60 LOW trades, or fewer than 15 sessions with both groups.
pass: HOLDS only if ALL: (1) mean d <= -5 bp with t <= -t_0.975(n-1) over all scored sessions; (2) LOW's pooled mean net < 0; (3) d's point estimate < 0 in BOTH periods P1 and P2 separately; (4) removing LOW (per session) beats removing the same number of trades chosen at random (1,000 seeded draws 'MTCL'), beats removing the same number with the widest entry spread, and beats removing the same number with the lowest range, each in >= 95% of draws (ties at the cut broken by seed 'MTCL-TIE', 100 draws); the book is LOW union REST, session-equal means; (5) (1)-(4) also hold with sessions 10/27-10/29 removed; (6) the power gate passed.
fail: Powered and any of (1)-(5) missed: NOT SUPPORTED. 'Refuted' only if the all-session upper one-sided 97.5% bound of d is > 0.
if_holds: Association only, never cited as an edge. It earns a replay gate test (a knob refusing arms whose move_to_cost < 8 at the arm, using the order-time spread, with a matched random refusal and forward sessions under '2 bp + average >= 0'), pre-registered separately.
information_only: Bands [0,4), [4,8), [8,16), >=16 by period; LOW vs REST win rate; the missing group's mean.
Drop top 3 days and top 5 names from d.
By price band (< $20, $20-100) and by source where outcomes.jsonl records it.

Second, independent check (separate script, information only until its own prereg): the same split on a seeded sample of historical empty-square entries (slope_now_hist events 2026-05-11..2026-10-13) with SIP quotes at the entry second.
no_retuning: No other cut-off, window or range length is scored.
script: tools/studies/move_to_cost_live.py (count -> score), reusing move_to_cost_holdout's Data class, statistics and controls, written after a result-skeptic READY; runs after hours.

amended.when: 2026-10-29 ~20:00 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 (FIX FIRST, 9), before any held-out trade is joined to a range or spread.
amended.1_rows: Keep only rows with entry_path == 'watch' and paper == true; this drops the 23 rows 8/4-8/11 without paper/book_owner (possibly another machine), the 3 'adopted' rows, the 9 scaled_out rows (8/12-8/27, exit_price prices the last tranche only), one copy of each exact duplicate (BCRX 8/11 10:41:09, DVN 8/25 10:13:40) and one row of each of the 2 overlapping same-symbol positions. Every drop is counted and reported.
amended.2_exit_price: exit_price only, never exit_price_approx. Rows with entry dates before 2026-08-07 are dropped (before fill-based exits, 7483a89d).
amended.3_fill_check: Every row is matched to Alpaca account FILL activities: same symbol, a buy within 120 s of entry_time and a sell within 120 s of exit_time; net uses the activity prices. Unmatched rows are dropped and counted; > 5% unmatched = VOID.
amended.4_range_window: Range uses the RTH minutes [m-21, m-1] before the entry minute m; entries before 09:51 count as missing (a truncated window shrinks the range and pushes early entries into LOW). The 10-bar minimum stays; bar counts are reported by group.
amended.5_price_confound: PRIMARY population: entries at $10 or more in both periods (the live floor); P1 has 268 entries under $10 and P2 none. All prices together are information only.
amended.6_strategy_mix: Rows with edge_mode == 'exhaustion_scalp' (71 in P1) are excluded. Source mix and LOW share by period are information only.
amended.7_power: The power gate (LOW >= 60, sessions >= 15, MDE <= 8 bp) applies to the without-10/27-10/29 set as well. P2 alone (9-12 sessions) is direction only.
amended.8_contamination: move_to_cost_holdout ran count and recheck only (UNDERPOWERED); no result.json exists and its information-only live-fill split was never computed, so no live-trade LOW/REST number has been seen.
amended.9_fill_model: The fills are Alpaca paper simulations, not real-book fills; the write-up states it.

amended_2.when: 2026-10-29 ~20:15 ET, result-skeptic round 2 (FIX FIRST, text only), applied verbatim, before any held-out join.
amended_2.R1_precedence: Where 'amended' or 'amended_2' conflicts with an earlier key, the later block governs. In particular, 'trades' no longer accepts exit_price_approx; the power gate applies to both sets (amended 7); and the primary population is amended 5 (>= $10) after amended 1, 2, 4 and 6.
amended_2.R2_fill_match: Buy side: all buy FILL activities (fill and partial_fill) for the symbol with transaction_time in [entry_time - 5 s, entry_time + 120 s]. Sell side: all sell FILL activities for the symbol in [last matched buy, exit_time + 5 s]. Each side is priced at its quantity-weighted average. Matched only if buy qty = sell qty = total_qty, and no other outcome row of the same symbol overlaps [entry_time - 5 s, exit_time + 5 s]. Otherwise the row is unmatched (dropped and counted; > 5% = VOID). The $10 floor is applied to the matched buy average.
amended_2.R3_overlap: For each of the 2 overlapping same-symbol pairs, both rows are dropped (their fills cannot be assigned). This replaces 'one row of each' in amended 1.
